v2.0.2

Latest November 21, 2026

Added

  • Release history page on the docs site (docs/changelog.html), generated from CHANGELOG.md by scripts/generate-changelog-page.js during npm version and linked from the landing page
  • GitHub Releases are now created automatically after a successful npm publish, using that version's CHANGELOG.md section as the release notes (scripts/extract-release-notes.js)

Changed

  • Updated dependencies, including ora 10 (CLI spinners)
  • CI security audit: npm audit now checks production dependencies only, while audit-ci audits everything with an allowlist (audit-ci.jsonc) for two dev-only advisories that have no upstream fix yet (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 in glob, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 in minimatch)
  • A failed npm publish now opens a GitHub issue instead of only logging a message

Fixed

  • README "Repo Story" link pointed at a file that no longer exists; it now links to a current repository story

v2.0.1

October 20, 2026

Fixed

  • --days no longer drops recent commits when the window reaches back past the repository's first commit. The adjusted start date was passed to git as a bare YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, which git reads as that date at the current local time of day; when the local and UTC dates differed (for example, US evenings) commits made earlier that day were silently excluded. The start is now a full UTC timestamp
  • Installing git-spark no longer triggers npm's "install scripts blocked" warning. The husky git-hook setup moved from postinstall to prepare, which runs only for contributors installing inside the repository, never for users installing the package from npm
  • The docs site sample report now covers the last 365 days instead of a 30-day window ending at the UTC date, which could produce an empty report when the workflow ran just after midnight UTC

v2.0.0

October 20, 2026

Breaking

  • Node.js 26.0.0 or newer is now required (previously 22.22.2). engines, .nvmrc, the CI matrix (26.0.0 and 26.x), and the README badge are aligned to the new minimum

Changed

  • Compile with TypeScript 7 while keeping the TypeScript 6 API for tooling (ESLint, Jest, TypeDoc)
  • Refactored GitAnalyzer and related modules for stronger typing of author and file metrics, safer regex validation, and improved error handling in the collector
  • Updated devDependencies to current releases

Security

  • Resolved GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (sprintf-js DoS, no upstream fix) in the dev toolchain by overriding argparse to 2.x under js-yaml@3; js-yaml only uses argparse in its CLI, so test and coverage behavior is unchanged

Internal

  • Replaced the Bold framework with DevSpark 9.2.0 and added Claude Code /devspark-* command entry points

v1.4.0

July 11, 2026

Not published to npm. The npm publish for this tag failed with an authentication error, so git-spark@1.4.0 was never released. Every change below shipped in 2.0.0.

Added

  • New git-spark periods command: compares commit churn and activity across consecutive fixed-length periods (e.g. sprints), with console, markdown, and HTML output formats (src/cli/periods-command.ts, src/core/period-summary.ts, src/output/periods-*.ts, src/types/periods.ts)
  • Shallow clone detection: GitExecutor.isShallowRepository() warns when a shallow clone may be missing commits needed for accurate period comparisons
  • Fast type-check in CI: typecheck:fast script using tsgo (TypeScript native preview) added as a non-blocking CI step
  • scripts/update-changelog.js: automatically promotes CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] section to a dated version section during npm version (wired in as the version lifecycle script), so npm run release:* keeps the changelog in sync with the version bump instead of requiring a separate manual edit

Changed

  • Hardened the scheduled dependency-update workflow (security.yml) with explicit contents: write / pull-requests: write permissions and persist-credentials: false on checkout

Removed

  • Removed the unimplemented --compare <branch> and --watch CLI flags and their unused ComparisonReport / ComparisonDifferences types

May 19, 2026

  • version-fallback-coverage test suite exercising the package.json fallback branch in version-fallback.ts

v1.0.170

October 7, 2025

Fixed

  • Critical Bug: First Commit Date Detection

    • Fixed getFirstCommitDate() method that was returning incorrect dates
    • Removed problematic --max-count=1 flag that limited results before reversing
    • Now uses --all --reverse to find true repository first commit across all branches
    • Resolves issue where --days=300 returned 0 commits despite recent activity

  • Date Range Calculation

    • Added repository lifetime capping to prevent analysis periods before first commit
    • Implemented timezone-safe date handling by subtracting 1 day from first commit
    • Fixed analysis period display showing impossible dates (before repository creation)
    • Added comprehensive debug logging for date comparisons

Changed

  • HTML Report Navigation

    • Positioned "Detailed Daily Tables" between Author Details and Limitations for logical flow

Technical

  • Modified src/output/html.ts - Navigation reordering and date display improvements
